title: 第25章 孙友文入伙，凝真血，成就武者
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
“爹。”

    齐梁山，一处无名山洞，孙友文拿着烤兔走进来。

    “兔子烤好了，您快趁热吃。”

    孙老爷一看到烤兔子就来气。

    “吃吃吃，吃什么吃，天天从早到晚就是吃烤兔子，烤鸡，烤鹿肉。”

    “老子稀罕吃你这些玩意儿吗？”

    孙老爷怒视孙友文，指着他的鼻子。

    “老二，你这个混账东西，想要内功心法，老子不是已经给你想办法筹钱了？”

    “你为何要，为何要勾结赤山盗，抢劫春税呢。”

    “咱们是民，他们是匪，老子兢兢业业努力一辈子，结果，就是为了在这荒郊野岭的，陪你一起吃烤兔子吗？”

    “你真是太让老子失望了。”

    “爹，我不是跟你认过错了吗，你怎么还念叨这些事。”

    “认个屁错，你孙友文厉害的很啊，这么大的事，都不跟我商量一下，你眼里还有我这个爹吗？”

    被骂的狗血喷头。

    孙友文眼中闪过一丝怨毒，但他很快收敛，“爹，这真不怪我，谁知那一个泥腿子，竟然能把余涛给杀了。”

    “我后来又托刘队长去看看情况，可是刘队长也一去不返。”

    “爹你放心，这个仇我一定会报，陆大虎当年活着就处处跟咱们家作对，他死了还不安生，让什么狗屁陆林来坏我好事，我一定会杀了他，给大哥报仇。”

    孙友文没有说，大哥孙友成是被余涛砍死的。

    “杀杀杀，一天到晚就知道杀，老子送你去武馆，是希望你能光宗耀祖，有朝一日能够通过武考，得个官身。”

    “你这王八蛋，真是把老子多少年的心血给毁于一旦啊。”

    孙老爷想到这里，差点背过气去。

    “爹！你够了！”

    孙友文终于忍不住了。

    “大哥死了，又不是我的错，我只是想尽快筹集资金，购买那一本功法。”

    “我这是为了自己吗，我还不是为了咱们家能够早日发展壮大。”

    “现在你还能坐在这里等我给你送上烤肉，可我呢，我还有什么，我什么都没有了！”

    孙友文歇斯底里。

    孙老爷却更愤怒。

    “孙友文！你现在胆子大了，连你爹我都敢吼是吗？”

    “来，你不是要杀吗，你先把老子杀了，来啊，杀啊，你的刀呢，你的剑呢，你来杀老子啊！”

    孙老爷梗着脖子，凑近孙友文。

    眼看他如此，孙友文也是怒气上涌，一把扔掉手中的烤兔，抄刀在手。

    “老东西，你当我不敢吗！”

    “给我死！”

    孙友文一刀斩下。

    血光崩现。

    孙老爷瞪大眼睛，楞楞的看着孙友文。

    似乎是第一次认识，这个自己亲手养大的儿子。

    寒风呼啸。

    孙老爷的尸身砸在地上。

    也砸在孙友文的心头。

    他一下清醒过来，扑在老爹身上。

    “爹，对不起，对不起，我刚才冲动了，爹你不要死啊，爹，对不起，对不起。”

    孙友文想要用手堵住孙老爷脖子上的伤口。

    可是他越是堵。
content_en:
"Dad."

Qiliang Mountain, an unknown cave, Sun Youwen walked in with a roast rabbit.

"The rabbit is roasted. Eat it while it's hot."

Mr. Sun became angry when he saw the roasted rabbit.

"Eat, eat, eat, eat whatever you want. From morning to night, I eat roasted rabbit, roasted chicken, and roasted venison."

"Do I care about eating these things of yours?"

Master Sun glared at Sun Youwen and pointed at his nose.

"Second brother, you bastard, if you want inner strength and mental skills, haven't I already found a way to raise money for you?"

"Why did you, why did you collude with the Chishan bandits to rob the spring tax?"

"We are the people and they are bandits. I have worked hard all my life, but in the end, just to eat roast rabbit with you in this wilderness?"

"You really disappoint me."

"Dad, didn't I admit my fault to you? Why are you still talking about these things?"

"I'm sorry, you, Sun Youwen, are very powerful. If you don't even discuss such a big matter with me, do you still think of me as your father?"

The scolded bullshit nozzle.

A trace of resentment flashed in Sun Youwen's eyes, but he quickly restrained himself, "Dad, it's really not my fault. Who would have thought that that mud-legged guy could actually kill Yu Tao."

"I later asked Captain Liu to check on the situation, but Captain Liu never returned."

"Don't worry, dad, I will definitely avenge this. Lu Dahu always opposed our family in every way when he was alive. He is still alive after he is dead. If I let some bullshit Lu Lin come to ruin my good deeds, I will definitely kill him and avenge my elder brother."

Sun Youwen did not say that his eldest brother Sun Youcheng was hacked to death by Yu Tao.

"Kill, kill, kill. You know how to kill all day long. I send you to the martial arts gym because I hope you can honor your ancestors and one day pass the martial arts exam and get an official status."

"You bastard, you really ruined all my years of hard work."

When Mr. Sun thought of this, he almost lost his temper.

"Dad! That's enough!"

Sun Youwen finally couldn't bear it anymore.

"It's not my fault that my eldest brother died. I just wanted to raise funds as soon as possible to buy that book of exercises."

"Am I doing this for myself? I am not doing this for our family to grow and develop as soon as possible."

"Now you can still sit here and wait for me to serve you barbecue, but as for me, what else do I have? I have nothing!"

Sun Youwen was hysterical.

Mr. Sun was even more angry.

"Sun Youwen! You are so bold now, you dare to yell at me even your father, right?"

"Come on, don't you want to kill? You kill me first. Come on, kill me. Where is your knife? Where is your sword? Come and kill me!"

Mr. Sun rubbed his neck and approached Sun Youwen.

Seeing him like this, Sun Youwen also became angry and threw away the roast rabbit in his hand with the knife in his hand.

"Old man, do you think I dare not!"

"Die!"

Sun Youwen chopped it off with one stroke.

Bloody light collapsed.

Mr. Sun's eyes widened and he looked at Sun Youwen in shock.

It seemed like it was the first time he met the son he raised by himself.

The cold wind howled.

Master Sun's body fell to the ground.

It also hit Sun Youwen's heart.

He suddenly woke up and threw himself on his father.

"Dad, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I was impulsive just now. Dad, please don't die. Dad, I'm sorry, I'm sorry."

Sun Youwen wanted to block the wound on Master Sun's neck with his hands.

But the more he got stuck.
